lessons.trigger_condition: Image-only official announcements and sparse broad search can miss official SNS event leads.
lessons.prevention_rule: Read bounded official banner labels and rotate six verified registry accounts through Google/Bing RSS once per six-hour slot; preserve cooldowns and require URL ownership plus shared-publisher game evidence.
validation_required: Bounded discovery, both independent providers, rotation and persisted cooldown
Attribution spoof, shared-publisher game separation, malformed responses and banner dedup
Game/country filter intersection, paging, reset isolation, CSP and exact historical source guards
lessons.safety_boundary: No login bypass, source trust escalation, invented event dates, cloud runtime, automatic grading promotion or physical tablet success claim.
